name: vigie
description: Vigie - real goals (Objectifs reels). Forge app for Jira: an objective is real only if work is attached to it AND the number that measures it moved in a way traceable to that work. Recomputes movement weekly, says whether the target is reachable and what it costs in days, and names goal theatre. (Codegeist 2026)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:limits && npm run check:functions && npm run check:manifest
scripts.check:site: for f in site/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
